headline: Five Services.
subtext: From one-time setups to ongoing monthly oversight — we have the right service for every stage of your compliance journey.

services.title: DM Check Implementation
services.description: Full setup of the official DM Check digital monitoring platform — configured to your restaurant's specific workflows and operations.

services.title: GMP-FSMS Program
services.description: A comprehensive Good Manufacturing Practices program that establishes the complete operational foundation your kitchen needs — covering facilities, people, processes and documentation.
features: Detailed PIC report after each visit

services.title: HACCP Manual Creation & Implementation
services.description: End-to-end development and implementation of a fully customised HACCP manual — built around your menu, kitchen layout, and operational processes to meet international food safety standards.
features: Hazard analysis across all menu items

services.title: Monthly Audit & Training
services.description: A focused monthly service covering internal audits and staff training — ideal for establishments that have their systems in place and need consistent oversight to stay compliant.

services.title: Monthly Hygiene Management
services.description: Our most comprehensive ongoing service — full hygiene and compliance management covering audits, training, supplier oversight, documentation and food safety culture development across your team.
